ideas.pitch: An AI-powered forecasting system that analyzes technical incident telemetry and models risks using Poisson regression and automated backtests.
ideas.title: IncidentLens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by combining predictive modeling with rolling backtests, following the winning pattern of technical rigor seen in AI forecasting hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent auditing system that reviews operational decisions and corporate policies for algorithmic bias using structured LLM validation.
ideas.title: PolicyAudit AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven multi-agent evaluation framework that previously secured first place by focusing on trust, safety, and algorithmic fairness.

ideas.pitch: An automated municipal waste classification and routing model combining computer vision and edge analytics to optimize recycling pickup.
ideas.title: EcoRoute AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a tangible physical sustainability problem with a working vision pipeline, mirroring successful runner-up entries at municipal and AI hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A localized risk assessment model processing weather and topographical data to predict and visualize regional wildfire escalation probabilities.
ideas.title: WildfireWatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a high-impact climate risk problem with quantifiable predictive metrics that appeal directly to judges looking for social and environmental value.

ideas.pitch: An immersive language-learning platform that extracts authentic conversational phrases and vocabulary from user-generated short-form video clips.
ideas.title: LinguaShorts
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies a fresh approach to user-generated media and NLP that successfully won university-level hackathons by focusing on practical, engaging consumer utility.
